Rank the best candidate DAGs by likelihood of matching all observations. A node reaches exactly the nodes marked 1 along directed paths. Avoid cycles. Return 4 distinct IDs in priority order.

Perturb(B) -> A:1 B:0 C:1 D:1 E:1 F:1
Perturb(C) -> A:1 B:0 C:0 D:1 E:1 F:1
Perturb(E) -> A:0 B:0 C:0 D:0 E:0 F:0
Perturb(F) -> A:0 B:0 C:0 D:0 E:0 F:0
Candidates:
1. Graph: A->D, B->C, C->A, C->D, C->E, C->F
2. Graph: A->E, B->C, C->A, C->D, C->E, C->F
3. Graph: A->F, B->C, C->A, C->D, C->E, C->F
4. Graph: B->A, B->C, C->A, C->D, C->E, C->F
5. Graph: B->C, C->A, C->D, C->E
6. Graph: B->C, C->A, C->D, C->F
7. Graph: B->C, C->A, C->E, C->F
8. Graph: B->C, C->D, C->E, C->F
